summary: The PR addresses an issue where manage.py changes are not tracked by the autoreloader, but it introduces some concerns regarding maintainability and test coverage.

issues.description: There are no additional tests provided to verify that manage.py changes are now correctly tracked by the autoreloader.

The addition of special handling for the '__main__' module may introduce complexity and reduce readability. It would be better to understand why '__main__' does not have a __spec__ and address that root cause if possible.
